# `>` — Sort down / Greater

Ranks: `∞` monadic, `0 0` dyadic

`>Y` sorts the major cells of `Y` descending, as `[⍒Y]⌷Y` does. Ties keep their order.

```bpl
>30 10 20           ⍝ 30 20 10
>"b" "a" "c"        ⍝ "c" "b" "a"
```

`X>Y` tests X > Y for reals. Pervasive; tolerant.

```bpl
1 2 3>2            ⍝ $f $f $t
```

See [`<`](less.qmd) to sort up, and [`⍒`](grade-down.qmd) for the indices that sort.
